rv.q: Daniel Bailey’s dynamic production pulses with the jazz played by Lyons, weaving music around the taut scenes.
Conviction and powerful authority are the hallmarks of every performance in this fizzing and compelling masterwork.
Headlong’s revival of Fences is impressively honed, with the simmering first act infusing significance into the explosive second.

cn.t: Critics praise this production of Wilson's classic as compelling and urgently relevant, with outstanding performances bringing complex family drama to life. The dynamic staging fizzes with energy across three gripping hours.
